location.accessibility: Accessible only via the west corridor; other exits are blocked by rubble or magical ward.
location.adventureSummary: A place of lost glory, haunted by echoes—both real and spectral—and hiding the first clues to the fate of the dwarven defenders.
dcChecks: History DC 13: Learn the significance of the banners and their connection to the Deepvault.
Perception DC 15: Notice a hidden pressure plate near the dais.
location.description: Once a grand audience hall, this expansive stone chamber is now fractured by seismic upheavals. The floor is uneven and treacherous, with stalagmites thrusting upward where the ground split. Ancient banners, faded nearly to gray, hang between cracked pillars. Every word spoken here seems to multiply, echoing through the darkness.
location.dmInstructions: The Echo Wraith is highly sensitive to noise—loud actions or combat draw its immediate attention. Roleplay opportunities exist if the party attempts to communicate in respectful silence or dwarven. Clever use of the echoes can allow the party to navigate or disorient the Wraith.

doors.description: A blocked archway choked with rubble and fallen banners.
doors.name: Collapsed East Passage

encounters.summary: The Echo Wraith attacks those who make noise, but can be placated or questioned if approached with silence and respect.

features.description: Tattered dwarven banners, some embroidered with cryptic warnings and ancient oaths.
features.name: Banners

features.description: The chamber magnifies all sounds, creating a disorienting, near-illusory effect.
features.name: Echoing Chamber

features.description: A shattered stone platform at the far end, stained with ancient blood.
features.name: Cracked Dais

lootTable: Worn Banner of the Deepvault (historical value, 40 gp)
Potion of Mind Shielding (advantage on saves vs. charm for 1 hour)

monsters.description: A spectral entity drawn to sound, its form shifting with every word uttered. Attacks those who break the silence with shrieks that can stun.
monsters.name: Echo Wraith

location.name: Hall of Echoing Stone
plotHooks: A hidden message in the banner's embroidery reveals the location of a concealed vault beneath the Sundered Depths.
Whispers from the Echo Wraith, if calmed, mention a dwarven spirit trapped further within.

traps.damage: 2d10 bludgeoning (falling debris if the collapsed passage is forced open unsafely)
